thread:
devon: Proposing a quiet-window for Orchid private rollout (tenant: orchid-core). Need release + ops ok. Date: 2026-04-07 23:00-01:00 UTC. Goal: 0->30% traffic in 3 stages over 40m. Image: rwinf/private-orchid-v2.0.0-20260407.

tara: FYI this includes the new request batching tweak + a change in priority routing. Are we locking down model and routing behavior?

devon: yes. Model pinned to redwood/opt-13b@sha256:7f3c...; routing policy pinned to "latency-prefer" and batch.max_tokens=2048. Details in runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/orchid-rollout-2026-04-07.

deploy-bot: [deploy scheduled] Canary scheduled by @devon at 2026-04-07T23:00:00Z. Playbook: https://runbooks.redwood/orchid-rollout-2026-04-07. Preflight token: pf-1809-orchid.

meena: quick ops note 1: we have a maintenance window for storage in ap-south-1 at 00:30 UTC; we'll keep Orchid in us-east-1 only. Also need to confirm KMS key usage for private tenant artifacts.

sam_ops: confirmed, we will constrain to us-east-1. KMS key orchid-prod-key available and rotation is scheduled later in the week, not today.

release_council: Acceptance criteria: p95 < 300ms, HTTP 5xx rate < 0.3%, model-level hallucination flagging false positives < 1%. Auto-rollback if 5xx > 0.7% for 3m or p95 > 450ms for 5m.

tara: ML quick-check: will run the synthetic prompt set against the pinned image and routing policy. Expect Q-sim delta < 0.7% on the business prompts.

meena: infra preflight: reserved slice orchid-private-canary-01, min GPUs=1, max=4. Network policies applied, secrets mounted, certs validated.

deploy-bot: [preflight] config-lint OK; image rwinf/private-orchid-v2.0.0-20260407 verified; slice reservation OK; smoke-run OK (basic inference loop).

devon: propose small smoke stage first: 0.5% traffic for 12m, then 5% for 12m, then 30% for 16m. Hold after final stage for 20m. Thoughts?

release_council: Sounds good. Add a synthetic traffic generator to ensure cold-starts exercised and prefix cache warmed.

tara: I'll run the eval suite at 1h and 10m before the window to confirm no drift. Also enabling kvcache.v1 compatibility flag off (we're using v3).

meena: Ops ask: enable throttle endpoint to cut traffic to 0 quickly. I've added a runbook step for emergency traffic cut and slice drain.

devon: adding rollback snippet to thread for quick action:
```bash
# emergency pinback to previous image
redwoodctl tenant pin --tenant orchid-core --image rwinf/private-orchid-v1.9.8-20260320 --reason "auto/ops rollback"
# pause routing to canary
redwoodctl traffic hold --tenant orchid-core --slice orchid-private-canary-01
# notify channels
redwoodctl notify --team eng-oncall --msg "Orchid canary rollback: pinned to v1.9.8"
```

deploy-bot: [timeline] 23:00 UTC -> 0.5% verifier (12m); 23:12 -> 5% stage (12m); 23:24 -> 30% stage (16m); 23:40 -> final hold/monitor (20m). Auto-rollback triggers active.

sam_ops: I approve from infra side. I'll monitor GPU memory and network QPS. Set alerts: memory>88% 5m, 95th latency >400ms 3m.

meena: infra ack. I've reserved additional warm nodes in the pool as backup.

tara: ML ack. Eval at -60m and -10m will be posted to the release doc.

release_council: :thumbsup: documenting final rollback policy in release notes. Ensure all traces include tag orchard_rollout_v2.0.0.

devon: tagging ops and release leads: @meena @sam_ops @release_council. Please react with :white_check_mark: when you sign off.

meena: :white_check_mark:

sam_ops: :white_check_mark:

tara: :white_check_mark: (ml)

devon: thanks everyone. I'll kick off per schedule. If anything changes ping #eng-oncall or DM. I'll post a short summary after the final hold.
